For a project inquiry, please include:

  • A short introduction to you and your work
  • Your genre and a brief synopsis
  • Approximate word count and manuscript status
  • The kind of support you’re seeking

Please begin with an introduction rather than sensitive personal records. Submission requirements and next steps can be discussed by email.
